details:
Sonavera – Hear the Earth

Sonavera is an interactive Earth data sonification project that transforms environmental information into sound, allowing people to experience Earth's changes through listening rather than relying only on numbers and graphs.

How Does It Work?

Sonavera combines environmental data, Arduino hardware, and a digital interface to create an interactive audio experience. The system processes environmental values, such as temperature and rainfall, and converts them into different sounds. As these values change, the audio experience responds, helping users recognize environmental variations through sound.

The interface also displays the environmental values, allowing users to connect what they hear with the corresponding data.

Tools and Technologies

We developed Sonavera using:

  • Arduino: To support physical interaction and environmental data input.
  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: To build the interactive application and connect environmental values with audio.
  • Visual Studio Code: To develop and organize the programming files
